name: ptcli-retorrent
description: AI-callable Chinese PT retorrent, upload, qBittorrent, and daily-candidate automation service.

auth.required_when: PTCLI_API_TOKEN is configured on the service.

safety.blocked_contract: When rules, duplicate checks, qBittorrent evidence, or required confirmations are missing, APIs return status=blocked with blockers and next_actions.

load_order: GET /v1/tools to refresh tool contracts when the service may have changed
POST /v1/readiness/bundle before manual retorrent or daily candidate submission

daily_candidate_digest.approval_flow: Only submit candidates through submit_daily_candidate_job after human approval and confirm_upload=true.

resume.restriction: Use job_control_summary.dry_run_request/recommended_request first, or fall back to job_handoff.recommended_request plus allowlisted overrides.

agent_instructions.role: Operate ptcli as a cautious local Chinese PT retorrent assistant. Prefer structured JSON APIs and never infer success without reading the relevant handoff fields.
must: Use source_url_check_and_submit for a user-provided source link plus target unless the user explicitly wants a dry run or split audit.
Read job_control_summary, blockers, next_actions, next_step, job_handoff, seedbox_live_validation_completion_report, closure_handoff, and closure_summary before choosing the next call.
Ask for explicit user confirmation before setting accept_rules=true or confirm_upload=true when it was not already supplied by the user.
Stop immediately when duplicate_check.exists=true and report duplicate_check.dupes.
Treat status=blocked as recoverable only when job_control_summary.recommended_call, next_step, or job_handoff.recommended_request names a safe tool.
Report final source, target, torrent hash, content path, uploaded torrent injection, seeding wait, summary_file, and blockers.
must_not: Do not upload or submit a daily candidate without confirm_upload=true.
Do not bypass site_policies, rule_obligations, policy_execution_handoff, or duplicate_check.
Do not assume rule_review_fingerprint placeholders satisfy manual review.
Do not mark a job complete from status alone; verify seedbox_live_validation_completion_report.ready_for_user_report=true and target uploaded seeding evidence.
Do not retry live upload after a duplicate, rule blocker, or missing uploaded torrent evidence unless the next_step explicitly allows recovery.
ask_user_when: accept_rules or confirm_upload is missing for live upload
site policy config_audit reports missing_fields or placeholder_fields
a rule obligation cannot be programmatically verified
multiple target trackers are requested and the next live target is ambiguous

closure_contract.next_step_source: job_control_summary when present, otherwise job_handoff or closure_handoff.next_step

actions.done: Read get_job_summary and report the completed source/target/qBittorrent evidence.
actions.stop_duplicate: Do not upload; report duplicate_check.dupes to the user.
actions.collect_confirmations: Ask the user for explicit accept_rules/confirm_upload confirmation before resume.
actions.configure_policy: Call site_policies or update PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES before live work.
actions.prepare_materials: Use closure_handoff.next_step or resume_job with allowlisted material overrides.
actions.repair_target_payload: Use closure_handoff.next_step after fixing target upload payload blockers.
actions.repair_qbit: Use closure_handoff.next_step after reviewing qBittorrent evidence and rate-limit blockers.
actions.resolve_blockers: Stop and report closure_handoff.blockers unless next_step provides a safe tool call.
actions.inspect: Read get_job_summary and report uncertainty; do not attempt live upload.

default_workflows.name: source_url_retorrent
default_workflows.description: Recommended flow when a user sends one source tracker link and a target tracker. The service infers tracker/torrent id, checks duplicates, then proceeds only when rules and confirmations allow.

runbook.continue_when: job_handoff.action!=wait and status not in queued,running

runbook.request_from: job_handoff.material_input_template or materials_handoff.resume_request_template plus parent job_id/source_url/target context
runbook.continue_when: metadata_prepare_handoff.ready=true and material_options contains IMDb/TMDb/Douban or PTGen fields
runbook.resume_with: metadata_prepare_handoff.next_step; prefer resume_job when parent_job_id is known

runbook.request_from: job_handoff.material_input_template or materials_handoff.resume_request_template plus parent job_id/source_url/target context
runbook.continue_when: materials_prepare_handoff.ready=true and material_options is not empty
runbook.resume_with: materials_prepare_handoff.next_step; prefer resume_job when parent_job_id is known, otherwise source_url_check_and_submit after gates are ready

runbook.request_from: metadata_prepare_handoff/materials_prepare_handoff material_options plus source_info, duplicate_check, rule_check, and qBittorrent content evidence
runbook.resume_with: target_package_handoff.next_step; run target_upload_preflight with an MTEAM-safe torrent file before live upload

runbook.request_from: target_package_handoff.target_upload_request plus confirm_upload, download_uploaded_torrent, inject_uploaded_torrent, wait_uploaded_complete, uploaded_save_path/path, qBittorrent category/tag/rate limits
runbook.resume_with: target_upload_handoff.next_step or resume_job when uploaded torrent download/injection/wait evidence is incomplete
stop_when: uploaded torrent seeding evidence missing after retry

runbook.resume_with: job_handoff when job_handoff.action=resume; pass only job_handoff.recommended_request plus allowlisted overrides for confirmations, paths, qBittorrent limits, or material files

default_workflows.name: manual_retorrent
default_workflows.description: Create the primary source URL plus target tracker job. It checks duplicates and only proceeds when rule, duplicate, and confirmation gates allow.

default_workflows.name: daily_candidates
default_workflows.description: Find up to 10 ranked source/target retorrent candidates, then submit approved candidates through the inherited-identity handoff.

default_workflows.name: resume_blocked_job
default_workflows.description: Resume a blocked/failed job using allowlisted next_command_argv emitted by ptcli summaries.

tools.description: Return the job result and parsed summary-file payload when available.

job_id.description: 32-character ptcli job id returned by a job creation endpoint.

tools.name: resume_job
tools.description: Create a follow-up job from the allowlisted next_command_argv generated by a blocked or failed job. Optional allowlisted overrides can add missing confirmations, paths, qBittorrent limits, or material files before the resume job is queued.

job_id.description: 32-character ptcli job id returned by a job creation endpoint.

dry_run.description: Preview the patched allowlisted resume command without creating a child job or executing it.

accept_rules.description: Optional resume override for --accept-rules; only true values are applied.

confirm_upload.description: Optional resume override for --confirm-upload; only true values are applied.

target_execute.description: Optional resume override for --target-execute; only true values are applied.

enrich_metadata.description: Optional resume override for --enrich-metadata; only true values are applied.

fetch_ptgen.description: Optional resume override for --fetch-ptgen; only true values are applied.

generate_bdinfo.description: Optional resume override for --generate-bdinfo; only true values are applied.

generate_mediainfo.description: Optional resume override for --generate-mediainfo; only true values are applied.

generate_screenshots.description: Optional resume override for --generate-screenshots; only true values are applied.

upload_screenshots.description: Optional resume override for --upload-screenshots; only true values are applied.

download_uploaded_torrent.description: Optional resume override for --download-uploaded-torrent; only true values are applied.

inject_uploaded_torrent.description: Optional resume override for --inject-uploaded-torrent; only true values are applied.

wait_uploaded_complete.description: Optional resume override for --wait-uploaded-complete; only true values are applied.

path.description: Optional resume override for --path.

screenshot_file.description: Optional single screenshot file override; use screenshot_files for multiple files.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued job before it starts. Running jobs are not force-stopped and return 409 so live tracker/qBittorrent work is not interrupted unsafely.

job_id.description: 32-character ptcli job id returned by a job creation endpoint.

reason.description: Optional audit reason for cancelling a queued job.

tools.name: agent_manifest
tools.description: Return an OpenClaw/Hermes-friendly skill manifest with OpenAPI, tool, auth, safety, and workflow metadata.

tools.name: deployment_check
tools.description: Check local ptcli deployment readiness: runtime imports, config mount, cookies/tmp/job/download paths, API token warning, and qBittorrent config presence. This does not contact trackers or qBittorrent.

tools.name: readiness_bundle
tools.description: Aggregate deployment, site-policy, daily-schedule, and live doctor handoff signals before an AI agent attempts retorrent automation. This endpoint never contacts trackers or qBittorrent.

source.description: Alias for source_url; source_url is preferred for this tool.

source_tracker.description: Optional tracker code when source is only an id, e.g. U2 or CHD.

target.description: Target tracker code(s), currently live upload closure is MTEAM-focused.

accept_rules.description: Required for source download and live upload automation.

path.description: Existing completed content path on the seedbox.

save_path.description: qBittorrent save path for source torrent download/injection.

uploaded_save_path.description: qBittorrent save path for uploaded target torrent injection.

qbit_upload_limit.description: Source torrent upload limit, e.g. 500KiB/s. If omitted, PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES may provide a default.

qbit_download_limit.description: Source torrent download limit, e.g. 20MiB/s. If omitted, PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES may provide a default.

uploaded_qbit_upload_limit.description: Uploaded target torrent upload limit, e.g. 2MiB/s. If omitted, PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES may provide a default.

uploaded_qbit_download_limit.description: Uploaded target torrent download limit. If omitted, PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES may provide a default.

mediainfo_file.description: Existing MediaInfo report file to include in the target upload package.

bdinfo_file.description: Existing BDInfo report file to include in the target upload package.

image_host_file.description: JSON file containing hosted screenshot URLs and local screenshot evidence.

image_host.description: Optional image host selector used when upload_screenshots=true.

screenshot_file.description: Single existing screenshot file; use screenshot_files for multiple screenshots.

screenshot_files.description: Existing local screenshot files to include in the target upload package.

screenshot_count.description: Screenshot count to generate when generate_screenshots=true.

enrich_metadata.description: Enrich source metadata before preparing the target package.

fetch_ptgen.description: Fetch PTGen/Douban description metadata before preparing the target package.

generate_mediainfo.description: Generate MediaInfo from the resolved local content path before preparing the target package.

generate_bdinfo.description: Generate BDInfo for Blu-ray content before preparing the target package.

generate_screenshots.description: Generate video screenshots from the resolved local content path before preparing the target package.

upload_screenshots.description: Upload local/generated screenshots to the configured image host before preparing the target package.

execute_if_no_duplicate.description: This endpoint treats the request as execute-if-clear; duplicate, rule, and confirmation gates still block unsafe work.

source_url.description: User-provided source tracker details or download URL. The service infers tracker and torrent id from this URL.

source_tracker.description: Source tracker code, e.g. U2 or CHD.

target.description: Target tracker code(s), currently MTEAM duplicate checks are supported.

accept_rules.description: Whether rule obligations have been manually reviewed for executable candidate templates.

source_id.description: Optional source torrent id when source_tracker is provided instead of a full source_url.

tools.name: site_policies
tools.description: Return the configured Chinese PT site policy matrix: automation gates, qBittorrent rate limits, seeding requirements, rule URLs, and manual review blockers. This does not contact trackers.

trackers.description: Comma-separated tracker codes or an array, e.g. U2,MTEAM.

source_tracker.description: Optional source tracker code when asking for a source/target pair.

target.description: Optional target tracker code(s) when asking for a source/target pair.

accept_rules.description: Whether manual rule review obligations are acknowledged for this policy read.

config.description: Path to data/config.py inside the container.
